verdict.rationale: Orrick has a dedicated Trademark, Copyright & Media practice page documenting a team that manages thousands of trademarks for hundreds of clients and has won major copyright litigation, which covers clearance, registration, and enforcement work. This is supported by a broader IP Counseling & Due Diligence practice and patent litigation expertise, showing a substantive, named IP practice group. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of trademark clearance search process or independent rankings/awards specifically for trademark practice, and no client testimonials specific to trademark enforcement.
